en.title: SUZURI Accessibility Walkthrough Leads Disability Tech Updates Highlights
en.summary: The SUZURI accessibility walkthrough conducted with Mogumo Planning and GMO Pepabo highlighted web accessibility improvements. Jamie Maguire's bulk alt‑text generator using Azure AI was released to streamline image descriptions. Community donations funded ADA‑compliant upgrades at Camp Rainbow, and an article stressed that news accessibility should not be mistaken for effortlessness.

highlights.title: Bulk Alt-Text Generator Web App Released
Community generosity creates ADA-accessible improvements at Camp Rainbow
Behind the Bylines: News should be accessible. It should not be effortless

zh-TW.summary: SUZURI 無障礙走查由 Mogumo Planning 與 GMO Pepabo 進行，凸顯網頁無障礙改進。Jamie Maguire 利用 Azure AI 發布批量替代文字生成器，方便圖片描述。社區捐助為 Camp Rainbow 建設符合 ADA 的設施，另有文章強調新聞無障礙不等於輕鬆取得。

highlights.title: SUZURI 无障碍走查已完成
批量替代文本生成器网页应用发布
